mapper.select: SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO , C.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATM_BIZ_DSNM , A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , A.ACTL_FX_REFNO , A.FX_REFNO_SRNO AS FX_REFNO_SRNO , B.CSNO AS AI_INPT_CSNO , B.CUS_KORL_NM AS AI_INPT_CUSNM , B.CUCR , B.KRBR_NM , (select NVL(F.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT, F.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT) FROM CSPD004TF F, CSPD002TG T WHERE F.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND F.INPT_MST_SRNO = T.INPT_MST_SRNO AND F.INPT_TASK_ID = T.INPT_TASK_ID AND F.INPT_SANCTION_NO = '19' AND F.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN = 'Y' AND T.INPT_BL_GRP_NO = '1') AS IMPT_NM , (select NVL(F.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT, F.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT) FROM CSPD004TF F, CSPD002TG T WHERE F.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND F.INPT_MST_SRNO = T.INPT_MST_SRNO AND F.INPT_TASK_ID = T.INPT_TASK_ID AND F.INPT_SANCTION_NO = '15' AND F.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN = 'Y' AND T.INPT_BL_GRP_NO = '1' ) AS EXPT_NM , (select NVL(F.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT, F.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT) FROM CSPD004TF F, CSPD002TG T WHERE F.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND F.INPT_MST_SRNO = T.INPT_MST_SRNO AND F.INPT_TASK_ID = T.INPT_TASK_ID AND F.INPT_SANCTION_NO = '57' AND F.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN = 'Y' AND T.INPT_BL_GRP_NO = '1' ) AS PORT_LOADING , (select NVL(F.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT, F.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT) FROM CSPD004TF F, CSPD002TG T WHERE F.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND F.INPT_MST_SRNO = T.INPT_MST_SRNO AND F.INPT_TASK_ID = T.INPT_TASK_ID AND F.INPT_SANCTION_NO = '60' AND F.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN = 'Y' AND T.INPT_BL_GRP_NO = '1' ) AS PORT_DISCH , (select NVL(F.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT, F.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT) FROM CSPD004TF F, CSPD002TG T WHERE F.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND F.INPT_MST_SRNO = T.INPT_MST_SRNO AND F.INPT_TASK_ID = T.INPT_TASK_ID AND F.INPT_SANCTION_NO = '148' AND F.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN = 'Y' AND T.INPT_BL_GRP_NO = '1' ) AS ORIGN_NM

UNION ALL
SELECT M.FX_ACNO AS ACTL_FX_REFNO ,M.TDOC_RCP_SRNO AS FX_REFNO_SRNO ,M.CUS_KORL_NM ,M.CSNO ,M.TDOC_RCP_CUCD AS CUCR ,M.XPO_NACD AS NACD ,M.HS_CD ,M.DACC_BRCD ,M.KRBR_NM FROM CSPD202TM M WHERE M.TDOC_RCP_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1},'-','') AND (#{inptAtmcBizDscd} = '1' OR #{inptAtmcBizDscd} IS NULL) AND M.INPT_ATMC_REQ_DSCD != '3' ) B , CSPD112TI C
WHERE A.INPT_RCP_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1},'-','')
AND A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = #{inptAtmcBizDscd}

AND UPPER(B.CSNO) = UPPER(#{aiInptListText1})
